verdict.rationale: Stripe says it partners with Visa and Mastercard so customers can issue on either network (docs-14), and that you can create commercial or consumer card programs with no setup fees (docs-17). That supports the core claim that network membership and program setup are the platform's problem. However, the only statement on time to live cards is a marketing line, "minutes, not months" (docs-25), not a documented onboarding timeline. Community posts also describe historical invitation-only access granted in rolling batches (comm-4, comm-7), which adds gating to the signup-to-first-card path. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of BIN sponsorship or the issuing-bank partner arrangement, a documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline or onboarding/approval steps, and independent corroboration of launch time.
